shared_prompt: Create ONE production-ready decorative illustration for the Ottawa Visuals public-data website. Match this established art direction precisely: very thick rounded dark navy #0B2545 outlines, clean opaque white interiors, solid teal #00ABA9 shapes, restrained amber #E8A124 accents. Flat vector-like raster art, bold simple silhouettes, uniform heavy line weight, rounded joins. No gradients, shadows, texture, text, letters, numbers, labels, watermarks, logos, flags or party symbols. Genuine transparent background. Compact wide 2:1 composition, centred, 8% transparent safe margin on all sides; clear at a small 230px-wide homepage thumbnail. Draw only a few strong overlapping forms, not many tiny details. Qualitative imagery, no charts purporting to show actual data and no geographic map outlines. Subject:

subjects.member-spending: A simple white public-expense ledger with two thick teal horizontal entry marks, a small navy-outlined parliamentary clock tower behind its left edge, and two compact amber coin stacks to the right. The clock face is a plain small white circle without numbers. Communicate parliamentary office spending and public records. Balance the tower, ledger and coins as one concise symbol. No dollar signs, politician portraits, seals or verdicts.
subjects.bc-elections: A white ballot box with a teal top and navy slot in the foreground. Two small white ballot papers with teal checkmarks angle toward the one slot to suggest vote consolidation. Behind the box on the left are two simple teal mountain peaks with white snow caps; one short amber wave curve near their base suggests the Pacific coast. Mountains are a small secondary motif; the ballot box is the main focus. Nonpartisan British Columbia election scenarios, not a result or prediction.
subjects.alberta-elections: A white ballot box with a teal top and navy slot in the foreground. Three small white ballot papers with teal checkmarks angle toward the one slot to suggest vote consolidation. Behind one edge of the box is a single bold amber wheat ear and a very small low teal foothill silhouette. Wheat is a small secondary motif; the ballot box is the main focus. Nonpartisan Alberta election scenarios, not a result or prediction.
subjects.healthcare: A simple white hospital building with a teal roofline and a single bold teal cross on its front, a small white hospital bed with a teal blanket in the foreground at its lower right, and one compact amber coin stack at its lower left. Communicate public healthcare funding, hospital capacity and staffing. Keep the building, bed and coins as one concise symbol. No red cross, medical-organization emblems, people, stethoscopes, pills, charts or dollar signs.
